answer: Sybil resistance works by forcing each agent identity to claim and continuously operate an exclusive haven on a shared computational reef, generating fresh raven-attested proofs from reef-derived entropy every interval: an attacker forging many sybils must fund parallel haven hardware and energy streams that scale linearly with the count of fakes, while honest agents amortize the single reef cost, rendering large identity farms economically unviable compared to per-identity rewards.
